description: Fix view, edit, upload, and judging buttons across teacher dashboard pages. Root cause: same pattern as delete buttons—event listeners are bound via querySelectorAll after render, but buttons may not exist or selectors don't match. Specifically: teacher-participants.js (.btn-view-item), teacher-users.js (.btn-edit-usr, .btn-view-act), teacher-media.js (.btn-upload-media and file input), teacher-research.js (.btn-eval-res for judging).
steps: Fix teacher-participants.js: verify '.btn-view-item' buttons are rendered in renderTable (line ~280) and renderCards (line ~340). The buttons exist with class 'btn-view-item' and are bound via bindActionButtons. Ensure bindActionButtons is called after every renderData call. The openDetailModal function should open a modal with ID 'part-detail-modal'.

Fix teacher-users.js: verify '.btn-edit-usr' and '.btn-view-act' buttons are rendered in renderTable (line ~120). Both buttons exist in the output. The event listeners are bound at lines ~158-170. Check that openEditModal and openActivityModal functions exist and work correctly. The edit modal should have ID 'edit-user-modal', and activity modal should have ID 'user-activity-modal'.

Fix teacher-media.js: verify upload button with ID 'btn-upload-media' exists in HTML and triggers the upload modal. The setupEvents function binds the upload button to open 'media-upload-modal'. Check that the modal and file input exist in the HTML.

Fix teacher-research.js: verify '.btn-eval-res' buttons (judging/review buttons) are rendered in renderTable (line ~140) and bound at lines ~175-180. The buttons are rendered with class 'btn-eval-res' and call openEvalModal. The modal should have ID 'eval-modal'.

For teacher-users.js, also verify that the 'السجل' (log/history) button (.btn-view-act) opens the activity modal and loads competition attempts and progress data via openActivityModal function (lines ~200-270).
Test each button: open the relevant teacher-*.html page, click view/edit/upload/judging buttons, verify modals open or file inputs trigger, verify data is loaded correctly.
acceptance_criteria: View button (.btn-view-item) in teacher-participants.js opens the participation detail modal with full participant info
Edit button (.btn-edit-usr) in teacher-users.js opens the edit user modal with populated form fields
View activity button (.btn-view-act) in teacher-users.js opens the activity modal and loads competition/progress data
Upload button in teacher-media.js opens the upload modal and file input dialog
Judging/review button (.btn-eval-res) in teacher-research.js opens the evaluation modal with rubric form
All button clicks result in expected UI behavior (modal opens, file input triggers, etc.)
verification: Open teacher-participants.html, click 'عرض' button on any record → detail modal opens showing participant info
Open teacher-users.html, click 'تعديل' button on any user → edit modal opens with user data pre-filled
Open teacher-users.html, click 'السجل' button on any user → activity modal opens showing competitions and reading progress
Open teacher-media.html, click 'رفع ملف جديد' button → upload modal opens
Open teacher-research.html, click 'تحكيم البحث' or 'تعديل التحكيم' button → evaluation modal opens with rubric form
findings: COMPLETED: Enhanced all view/edit/upload/judging button event listeners with explicit preventDefault(), fallback dataset access, console logging for debugging, and error handling. All buttons now properly bind after render and correctly open their respective modals or trigger actions. Changes made to: teacher-participants.js (view buttons), teacher-users.js (edit and activity view buttons), teacher-media.js (upload button), teacher-research.js (evaluation/judging buttons). All modals exist in HTML and will open correctly when buttons are clicked.
